input: Hi there, I’m writing in a bit of a rush because I’m stuck in traffic and need to sort this out before my next meeting. I recently purchased a new commuter bike from you, and I’m trying to maximize my loyalty points to offset the cost of a mandatory safety inspection I have to get done immediately. I currently have exactly 100 points in my account. I know your standard policy states that 100 points equal a $5.00 discount, which is great, but I’m hoping you might make a one-time exception for me. Since I’m a regular commuter who relies on this bike daily, could you perhaps apply a slightly higher value to these 100 points, or perhaps waive the inspection fee entirely as a goodwill gesture? I understand this is outside the usual rules, and I’m not asking for a full refund or anything drastic. I just need a little extra help to cover this unexpected expense while I’m on the go. I really appreciate your time and any flexibility you can offer. Thanks so much.
